description: The curated id an unserved relation's generated not_served declaration takes, when the curated schema (identifiers.json, process/) already names that table by it: the generated type keeps the id, its anchor and its markings, so the table has one declaration. A named relation the source serves, or does not declare, fails generation: curate its served type and drop the name.

public.app_pick_list.note: The order lifecycle rail's last step (process/sales_order_lifecycle.json pick_list): until it is served, a pick stage is always unknown, never missing.

public.formula.note: The FM formula, authoritative for the formula code (identifiers.json formula_code); app_formulation is the gold copy.

public.app_bill_of_materials.note: The versioned assembly/packaging BOM header; ProductComponent (the FM finished-good component list) is the served approximation.

public.app_eqms_record.note: The eQMS record its number names (identifiers.json eqms_number, D|CC|CAPA|QRM-{YY}{seq}); batch QC results are on Batch (quality_controlled).
